issues.title: Missing: Content-Security-Policy
issues.description: No CSP header. XSS attacks are not mitigated by the browser.
issues.nginx_fix: add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self';" always;
issues.apache_fix: Header always set Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'"

issues.title: Missing: X-Frame-Options
issues.description: No X-Frame-Options. Site can be embedded in iframes (clickjacking risk).

issues.title: Missing: X-Content-Type-Options
issues.description: No X-Content-Type-Options. Browser may MIME-sniff responses into executable content.

issues.title: Missing: Referrer-Policy
issues.description: No Referrer-Policy. Full URL including query params may leak to third parties.

issues.title: 2 sensitive paths exposed
issues.description: Sensitive paths found in robots.txt or sitemap.xml. Attackers use these as reconnaissance targets.

issues.title: 25 risky subdomain(s) found
issues.description: Potentially sensitive subdomains are publicly resolvable: admin.edwardsnowden.substack.com, dev.edwardsnowden.substack.com, staging.edwardsnowden.substack.com, test.edwardsnowden.substack.com, beta.edwardsnowden.substack.com. These may expose admin panels, databases, or development environments.

issues.title: Port 8080 (HTTP-Alt) is open
issues.description: Service HTTP-Alt on port 8080 is publicly accessible. Banner: None
issues.fix: Restrict port 8080 via firewall unless public access is required. Use VPN for admin services.

issues.title: Port 8443 (HTTPS-Alt) is open
issues.description: Service HTTPS-Alt on port 8443 is publicly accessible. Banner: None
issues.fix: Restrict port 8443 via firewall unless public access is required. Use VPN for admin services.

issues.title: Dangerous HTTP methods enabled: PUT, DELETE
issues.description: HTTP PUT, DELETE method(s) are accepted. PUT can upload files, DELETE can remove resources. Unless this is an intentional API, these should be disabled.
issues.fix: Disable PUT, DELETE methods unless needed for API functionality.

issues.title: 2 secret(s) found in JavaScript: Stripe Key
issues.description: Sensitive data found in JavaScript files: Stripe Key. These credentials are visible to anyone viewing the page source. Attackers scan for these patterns automatically.
issues.fix: Remove all secrets from client-side JavaScript. Use server-side API proxies instead of exposing API keys. Rotate any exposed credentials immediately.

issues.title: No SPF record found
issues.description: Without SPF, anyone can send emails pretending to be from this domain.
issues.fix: Add SPF record: edwardsnowden.substack.com. IN TXT "v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com -all"

issues.title: No DMARC record found
issues.description: Without DMARC, email receivers cannot verify if emails from this domain are legitimate.
issues.fix: Add DMARC record: _dmarc.edwardsnowden.substack.com. IN TXT "v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc@edwardsnowden.substack.com"

issues.title: No DKIM record found (common selectors checked)
issues.description: No DKIM signing detected. Emails cannot be cryptographically verified as authentic.
issues.fix: Configure DKIM signing in your mail server and publish the public key in DNS.

issues.title: 38 POST form(s) without CSRF token
issues.description: Forms without CSRF protection: free?nojs=true, free?nojs=true, free?nojs=true, free?nojs=true, free?nojs=true
issues.fix: Add CSRF tokens to all POST forms.

issues.title: CSP Grade D — 3 weakness(es)
issues.description: Weaknesses: script-src: MISSING; object-src: MISSING; base-uri: MISSING. 0 bypass vector(s).

issues.title: User input reflected WITHOUT HTML encoding
issues.description: Input is reflected without encoding at: Search ?q=, Search ?search=, Query ?query=, Page ?p=, ID ?id=, Redirect ?redirect_to=, Callback ?callback=. HTML/JavaScript injection may be possible.
issues.fix: HTML-encode all user input before rendering. Add Content-Security-Policy header.

issues.title: GET forms with text inputs: email, email
issues.description: Forms using GET method place user input in the URL, making reflected XSS easier to exploit via crafted links.
issues.fix: Use POST method for forms where possible. Validate and encode all input.

issues.title: SQL error messages on parameters: wp_endpoint
issues.description: SQL injection payloads triggered database error messages on parameter(s) wp_endpoint. Database type: wordpress. This confirms that user input reaches the SQL query without proper sanitization. An attacker can extract the entire database contents including user credentials.
issues.fix: Use parameterized queries (prepared statements) for ALL database queries. In WordPress: always use $wpdb->prepare(). Update all plugins to latest versions. Disable detailed error messages in production (WP_DEBUG = false).
